item_name: Rothco Thin Blue Line Flag Commando Wallet
item_short_desc: Rothco's classic tri-fold commando style wallet embroidered with the Thin Blue Line Flag.
description: Rothco's classic tri-fold commando style wallet embroidered with the Thin Blue Line Flag. The wallet features 5 inside pockets and a secure hook and loop closure.  The 5 pockets are ideal for holding money, cards, and multiple forms of ID. The Thin Blue Line is a symbol of respect and support for Police and Law Enforcement Officials; show your support with Rothco's Thin Blue Line Flag Commando Wallet.
